notes.title: 🌟 Update News for Celestial Contact
notes.notes:
🌟 Exciting News for Celestial Contact Players! 🌟

We are excited to announce the release of v1.02 for Celestial Contact! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you new features, improvements and bug fixes that we know you'll love.

Here's what you can expect:
🚀 New Features:
[list]
[*] Damage Indicator: There are now damage indicators that show how much damage you've dealt to enemies!

[*] Loot Indicator: You can now instantly see what you've collected as loot from enemies!

[*] Animations: We've made some animations for a better gameplay experience, such as the intro animation, boss encounter and death animation.
[/list]
🔧 Improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved Gameplay: Optimization of difficulty levels in enemy waves to improve gameplay and enjoyment.
[/list]
🐛 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Known bugs have been fixed to ensure a smooth experience.
[/list]
We are grateful for your continued support and look forward to you discovering new content. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions.

Thank you for being part of the Celestial Contact community. Together we will continue to save stations and protect the planet! 🌠

notes.title: 🌟 Exciting News for Celestial Contact
notes.notes:
🌟 Exciting News for Celestial Contact Players! 🌟

We are thrilled to announce that the first update for Celestial Contact is released! Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you new features, improvements, and bug fixes that we know you’re going to love.

Here's what you can expect:
🚀 New Features:
[list]
[*] Supported Languages: You can now play Celestial Contact in your local language! With our newly added language support, you can play the game in 9 new languages: Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian.

[*] Advanced Tutorials: An interactive How To Play section with gameplay tips has been added for a better understanding of the game. 

[*] Store Update: Tired of Luke wearing the same outfit? No problem! You can now buy 3 new costumes with different upgrades in the STORE.
[/list]
🔧 Improvements:
[list]
[*] Control Improvements: Improvements to keyboard and controller keys.

[*] PS Controller Support: Added full support for the PlayStation controller.

[*] Improved Gameplay: Optimisation of difficulty levels in enemy waves to improve gameplay and enjoyment.
[/list]
🐛 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed known bugs to ensure a seamless experience.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued support and can’t wait for you to explore the new content. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions.

Thank you for being a part of the Celestial Contact community. Together we will continue to save stations and protect the planet! 🌠
